name: 3d-fabric
description: The complete 3D modelling and 3D-printing toolchain for one machine, in one plugin: probe the local SolidCraft install, run an agent-written script headlessly, export STL/STEP/3MF/OBJ, edit an existing design with --in, recover its command list with script, measure volume/mass/topology, render PNG previews, and inspect watertightness, non-manifold edges, normals and size with trimesh. Repairs meshes that came from elsewhere.

external_requirement.name: SolidCraft
external_requirement.missing_message: 请先在本机安装 SolidCraft 软件并配置环境变量，才能使用自然语言建模功能。
